title: Multiply and divide integers
status: draft: written by Claude, waiting for owner review

sections.title: Multiply integers
sections.objective: Multiply the sizes, then use the sign rule.
sections.key: Multiply the sizes, then count the negatives: even gives positive, odd gives negative.
sections.workedCaption: Follow the pattern down the list.

sections.title: Divide integers
sections.objective: Divide the sizes, then use the same sign rule.
explain: Every division is a multiplication backwards.
sections.key: Dividing uses the same sign rule as multiplying: one negative gives negative, two give positive.

sections.title: Putting it together
sections.objective: Multiply and divide integers, mixed together.
sections.key: Multiply or divide the sizes. Then count the negatives: even gives positive, odd gives negative.

hints.int.mult-div.multiply: Multiply the sizes. Then count the negatives: even means positive, odd means negative.
hints.int.mult-div.divide: Divide the sizes. One negative: the answer is negative. Two negatives: positive.
hints.int.mult-div: Work out the size first, then count the negatives: even means positive, odd means negative.

misconceptionMessages.int.mult-sign: The size is right, but check the sign: count the negative numbers. An even number of negatives makes the answer positive; odd makes it negative.
misconceptionMessages.int.div-sign: The size is right, but check the sign: dividing uses the same rule as multiplying. Two negatives make a positive.
